caption: The video captures a close, largely fixed view of two pale blue-white ice pieces resting on a wet, reddish-brown stone ledge. A larger, rounded rectangular block stands tilted upright toward the right, while a smaller, flatter rounded piece lies to its left. A thin sheen of water and glistening reflections surround their bases against a softly blurred background of trees, an open field, and a tall structure. The upright block appears to melt gradually, its rounded top edge lowering and its height diminishing while its lean and position remain largely unchanged. The smaller piece likewise loses a little vertical extent, flattening slightly. The water film around both bases remains visible, with only slight changes in its spread. The framing and relative positions remain largely constant, with no obvious camera movement.
relations: Ambient warmth at the wet ledge transfers into the ice, slowly reducing the upright block's height while its lean persists.
The smaller flat piece loses vertical extent as meltwater pools at its base, keeping its left-side position fixed.
Meltwater film around both bases remains visible, spreading only slightly as the ice volume diminishes.
The blurred background and ledge framing stay constant, so only the ice shapes change over the short clip.
